channel.title: Jeremy Canale, blog (English)
channel.description: Incident analyses, architecture proposals and free resources on securing agent platforms, cloud estates and their governance.

item.title: DGF-Bench: A Benchmark for Simulating and Auditing Deception Against Multi-Agent Governance Boards
item.description: A board of agents reviews synthetic dossiers under 61 executable rules while an attacker plants deceptive content in the evidence the organization does not vouch for. Attacks that imitate the organization's own process passed against four of six models; direct orders and false authority almost never did.

item.title: Can AI take over the reviews that decide a project’s future?
item.description: I ran an AI agent through 300 fictional projects to see whether it can carry out the reviews that decide a project’s future, all the way to the decision. It can, under conditions. The harder question is how much human work remains.

item.title: The Last Human Gate: Forward Deployed Engineering for Governance Automation
item.description: A task-substitution framework for Digital Governance Frameworks, treating each gate as an executable contract, with a residual-work threshold that explains why automating most cases can still increase total human work. Measured on 300 synthetic projects and 899 evaluable runs.

item.title: SOC and Blue Teaming: two applied AI use cases for security operations
item.description: An investigation agent for the SOC, a malware triage pipeline for the Blue Team, the trust architecture behind both, and a business case: about €456k of net benefit a year and a 10.5-month payback in the modeled scenario.

item.title: The race for capability. The lag in control.
item.description: What the warnings from Anthropic, OpenAI and Musk mean for any company delegating work to agents: alignment, monitoring and the scope of autonomy.

item.title: Case study: Hardening the OpenAI ExploitGym environment
item.description: Restrict agent Internet access to explicitly allowed destinations.

item.title: Security Architect: the survival kit
item.description: Where to stand in the Digital Governance Framework (DGF): gates, contract, CIA+TN reading grid, Azure and AWS IAM, risk matrix, AI projects.
